testCases.label: Verify Circle inherits from Shape and overrides area()
testCases.description: Checks that a Circle instance is a subclass of Shape and has an overridden area() method.

testCases.label: Verify Circle area calculation is correct
testCases.description: Ensures that Circle.area() returns approximately 78.54 when the radius is 5.

testCases.label: Verify Rectangle inherits from Shape and overrides area()
testCases.description: Checks that a Rectangle instance is a subclass of Shape and overrides the area() method.

testCases.description: Ensures that Rectangle.area() returns 24 for a rectangle with width 4 and height 6.
